text: Kevin's driving test is May 14 at 9am. He's failed twice already and sounded properly nervous on the phone. Text him good luck that morning.
Ann is pregnant! Due in early March. She's had awful morning sickness so far, so maybe hold off on the food-based gifts.
Tariq got his A-level results today: two A*s and a B. He's off to Leeds for medicine.
Leon mentioned he's been getting into vinyl lately, mostly old soul records. Birthday is June 3rd. A record voucher would go down well.
Ayo and Vera's son's christening is on 7/12. I'm doing the cake.
Heather's grade 8 piano exam was yesterday. Need to ask her how it went.
Salma said her sister Ines just had a baby girl on Tuesday night. Both doing well.
Amir is really into bouldering now and goes three times a week. His wife Jasmine thinks he's obsessed.
Pick up a card and wrapping paper on the way home.
Joe's theory test got moved to April 22nd. The practical is about six weeks after that if he passes.
Adaeze told me she's expecting twins! Scan on September 9. She's thrilled but a bit overwhelmed. Don't forget to check in the day after the scan.
Wiremu turns 40 on August 2nd. His partner Hemi is throwing a surprise party at their place the Saturday before. Don't tell him.
Carlos is auditioning for the youth orchestra on 3/28. Remind me to message him the night before.

Coffee with Kate this morning. Her son Mateo starts his GCSEs next week and honestly she seems more stressed than he is. She says he's barely revising and spends every evening on the Xbox with his friends. His first exam is maths on May 15, then physics the day after. Her husband thinks she should back off a bit. She's promised him a trip to Barcelona if he does well.
Vikram passed his driving test first time! Send him a congrats text.
Juan's daughter Ruby has her ballet audition for the Royal Ballet School on February 11th. Juan is driving her down the day before and they're staying overnight.
Chiara loves anything lemon-flavoured, and she's gluten free. Worth remembering for her birthday on October 30.
Olga's baby shower has been cancelled because she's on bed rest. The baby is due November 18th. I should call her this weekend to see how she's doing.
Lorenzo got a distinction in his grade 5 violin. His mum Francesca was beaming.

Elijah mentioned that his little brother Rafael has his eleven-plus on 9/14 and the results come out in October. The whole family is on edge. Rafael is quite a nervy kid and had a meltdown at the mock last month. Their mum has hired a tutor twice a week, and Elijah has been helping him with verbal reasoning in the evenings. Elijah says he just wants it over with. Text Elijah the day after to see how Rafael got on.

Carmen's birthday is Dec 4. She's been dropping hints about a new pair of running shoes, the Hoka ones, because her old pair is falling apart. She also mentioned she's been getting into pottery and has a class on Tuesday nights. Her girlfriend Olga said she's planning a weekend away for them the week after, somewhere in the Lakes. Could go halves with Olga on the shoes if she hasn't already bought them.
Mrs Fischer next door said her granddaughter was born last Sunday, 8lb 2oz. Pop a card through her door.
Ilse has her citizenship test on May 6th. She's been studying every night and seems fairly calm about it.

Fatima Usman and her husband are having their son christened on June 21st, with lunch at the Swan afterwards. We're both invited. She asked if I'd be a godparent, which I said yes to. The rehearsal at the church is the Thursday before. Her mother-in-law is flying in from Lagos a week before and staying for a month, which Fatima is slightly dreading. I need to sort out a proper christening gift, maybe a silver bracelet, and I should ask her what the dress code is.

Results day for Heather's nursing exams is August 15. Text her that afternoon. She's applied for a band 5 job at St Mary's, and the interview is the week after results, so it's a big month for her. Her mum is also having a knee replacement around then, which isn't helping her stress levels at all. She mentioned she'd love to get away somewhere quiet once it's all done.
Tariq's mum had her hip operation on Monday. He said she's in good spirits but sore.

Just got off the phone with Ayo. The baby is finally sleeping through the night, so they're both human again. Ayo goes back to work on 1/6 and is dreading it a bit. Vera's mum is going to look after him three days a week, and they've found a nursery for the other two. I must remember to send the photos from the christening, and I should drop round some dinners the week before she starts back.

Kevin failed his test again. Minor faults on roundabouts, apparently, and one serious one for not checking his mirror pulling out. He's rebooked for July 9th, which gives him about seven weeks. His instructor thinks he's ready and it's mostly nerves now. He was gutted and kept saying he'd let his dad down. Must check in on him tomorrow, and I should offer to take him out for practice drives the weekend before the new test.
Note to self: book my own driving lesson for Thursday and renew the provisional licence.
Ann's birthday is on the 17th, two weeks before her due date. She said all she wants is a decent night's sleep and maybe a foot massage voucher.
Leon's girlfriend Kate is sitting her bar exam in Feb. He says she's barely sleeping.
Saw Juan at the school gate. Ruby got into the Royal Ballet School! They found out on Friday.
Vera collects vintage teapots. Has about thirty.
Salma's driving test on 10/23 is the same day as her nephew's naming ceremony, so she's going straight from the test centre to the ceremony. Ring her that evening to find out how both went.
Amir and Jasmine are expecting their first baby in April. They're not finding out the gender. Jasmine's craving pickles constantly.

Long chat with Ines tonight. The baby is three weeks old now and not feeding well, and Ines is exhausted and a bit low. Her husband Joe goes back to work on Monday, which she's anxious about. Her mum is coming to stay the week after. I need to check in with her on Monday morning, and I should organise a meal train with the others.
Wiremu's party went off brilliantly. He had no idea. Hemi pulled it off.
Adaeze's baby shower is on October 4th. Ask Hemi whether we're chipping in for the pram together.
Carlos didn't get into the youth orchestra. He's taking it hard, and his dad says he wants to quit cello altogether.
Dr Nguyen is retiring at the end of June. Her leaving do is on June 27th.
Mateo got 9s in maths and physics! Kate sent a picture of him with his results. I should send him a little something.
Vikram's into Formula 1 and craft beer. He supports Ferrari, for his sins.

Called Chiara. Her brother Lorenzo has his music college audition on March 3rd, and she's going with him for moral support. He's been practising six hours a day. The results come out a week after, and their parents are flying in from Milan the day before the audition. Remind me to text Lorenzo good luck that morning.
Olga had the baby! A boy, born November 12th, a week early. Dad Rafael says they're home and doing fine.
Elijah's SATs start on May 12. He says he isn't worried at all.
Ilse passed her citizenship test. Ceremony is on 7/19 and she's asked me to come.
Carmen's half marathon is the Sunday after her birthday. She's been training since August.
Fatima mentioned her daughter is sitting her driving test on April 30. Fatima is more nervous than the daughter is.
Need to buy a christening present for Ayo and Vera's little one and get it engraved.
Hemi's dog Bluey had surgery on her leg on Friday. Hemi was really worried. Ask him how she's recovering.
Kate Lopez from work is pregnant with number three. She told me in confidence, so keep it quiet for now.
Francesca's birthday dinner on March 15 is off. She's come down with flu. Don't forget to send her some flowers.

Rafael's mum turns 70 on September 8th. He's organising a family trip to Portugal for the week after, renting a villa near Lagos for all twelve of them. His sister Carmen is handling the cake and a photo book. His mum has no idea yet. They're telling her at Sunday lunch the day before her birthday. Rafael asked if I could design the invitations, so I should get a draft to him by the end of the month.
Joe said his cat Pickle had kittens last night, five of them. He's trying to rehome three.
Ann had the baby on 2/27! A girl. Ann's partner Kevin texted at 4am. Visit them next week once they've settled in, and take the knitted blanket.
Heather passed her nursing exams and starts at St Mary's in September. She's over the moon.
Leon's into board games, the heavy strategy ones. His birthday is in a fortnight. Ask Tariq which ones he already owns.
Ayo mentioned Vera's dad is having heart tests on Wednesday. She's worried but trying not to show it.
Uncle Amir's 60th is on August 19th, and the family is doing a meal the night before. I'm bringing dessert.
Ines Wang finally sat her driving theory test on June 10. She passed with 49 out of 50. Joe took her out to celebrate afterwards.
